recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It preserves the later FHIR-53139 component-based model while correcting the only stale source text found for the FHIR-20723 valueSet guidance; no follow-up is needed in core unless the work group reopens whether value-based stratifier value sets should again exist at the top-level stratifier element.
issue_request: FHIR-20723 was an Applied CQI change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking to capture reporting availability or disaggregation levels for MeasureReport. The approved approach was to represent this through Measure stratification rather than by adding a MeasureReport-only attribute, adding valueSet and unit support to the Measure stratifier/component/supplementalData areas and example stratifier terminology.
initial_application: The initial terminology-family application appears in git commit 0d1966daedd8, which generated Measure example code systems and value sets including age/gender/region stratifier examples. The Jira-linked HL7/fhir#3423 application includes git commit 9e39654ec7c1, which added valueSet and unit elements to Measure.group.stratifier, Measure.group.stratifier.component, and Measure.supplementalData, plus an HIV indicators example using the new component valueSet.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists both measure=Measure and measurereport=MeasureReport, and source/hierarchy.xml lists clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html as the active Quality Reporting topic. Later Applied issue FHIR-53139 clarified that value-based stratifiers are represented with stratifier component elements and removed the now-stale top-level Measure.group.stratifier.valueSet and Measure.group.stratifier.unit elements. Later Applied issue FHIR-51028 deliberately changed the base example stratifier terminology from age/gender/region to an example Measure Stratifier Type set with age-range/gender/facility, so the original region-code details are superseded by later terminology policy.
reconciliation: Updated source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html so the value set guidance points to the current component-level element, stratifier.component.valueSet, instead of saying that a removed top-level stratifier valueSet element may be used. No MeasureReport element was added because the current approved design captures the reporting levels through Measure definitions and MeasureReport linkage.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html:492 changed value-set guidance from the removed top-level stratifier valueSet element to stratifier.component.valueSet.

related_jiras.note: Clarified value-based stratifier semantics and removed the top-level Measure.group.stratifier.valueSet/unit elements, which governs the current FHIR-20723 reconciliation.
Revised the example Measure stratifier terminology from the older age/gender/region set, superseding that part of the original FHIR-20723 resolution.
Further clarified component.criteria behavior for value-based stratifiers and supports reading value-set guidance as component-level guidance.
